title: Project 2
text:
Research Questions
I am interested in 3 main questions:

Which states have the highest sales, number of orders, and number of customers?


What do customers in these states buy most often?
Are the sales in these states profitable?


State Summary

# summarize sales, profit, orders, and customers by state

# `n_distinct()` counts unique values instead of every row 

state_summary <- superstore |>
  group_by(State) |>
  summarize(
    total_sales = sum(Sales),
    total_profit = sum(Profit),
    profit_margin = total_profit / total_sales * 100,
    total_orders = n_distinct(`Order ID`),
    total_customers = n_distinct(`Customer ID`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# show top 10 states by number of sales 

top_states <- state_summary |>
  arrange(desc(total_sales)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

title: Project 2
text:
Graphical Summaries

Bar Chart

# Top 10 States by Total Sales (Q1)

ggplot(top_states, aes(
  x = reorder(State, total_sales),
  y = total_sales
)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 States by Total Sales",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total Sales ($)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()










Side-By-Side Bar Chart

# Sales by Product Category Across Top States (Q1 & Q2)

state_cat_sales <- superstore |>
  filter(State %in% top_states$State) |>
  group_by(State, Category) |>
  summarize(
    total_sales = sum(Sales),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  state_cat_sales,
  aes(x = State, y = total_sales, fill = Category)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Sales by Product Category Across Top 10 States",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total Sales ($)",
    fill = "Product Category"
  ) +
  theme_bw()










Scatter Plot

# Total Sales vs. Total Profit by State (Q3)

ggplot(state_summary, aes(
  x = total_sales,
  y = total_profit,
  color = total_profit
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
